tex_content.label: eq:singular-retained-region
tex_content.html:
\begin{equation} \begin{split} \Omega =\{ x\in M:\ & \exists B\in \mathbb R\ \forall t_0<T \exists t\in [t_-,T),\\ & t_0<t\text{ and }R_{\rm ref}(t,x)\leq B\} . \end{split} \end{equation}

The definition uses a finite liminf. Eventual boundedness is a conclusion. At exceptional old times we use the all-time analytic inequalities and continuity, rather than assume canonical control.
